name: sparsew2t smoke on Kaggle CPU (12 tests + one synthetic run)
command: set -o pipefail; O=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; echo '[1/4] pip'; pip install -q tabulate baostock 2>&1 | tail -n 5 | tee $O/pip.log; echo '[2/4] versions'; python -c 'import sys, torch, pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn; print(sys.version, torch.__version__, pandas.__version__, numpy.__version__, scipy.__version__, sklearn.__version__)' 2>&1 | tee $O/versions.txt; echo '[3/4] tests'; OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -W ignore tests/test_smoke.py 2>&1 | tee $O/test.log | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|passed|Error|assert' ; grep -q '12/12 passed' $O/test.log || { echo 'TESTS FAILED'; tail -n 60 $O/test.log; exit 1; }; echo '[4/4] smoke run'; OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 python -W ignore scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/smoke.yaml --override experiment.device=cpu --out $O/run > $O/run.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 60 $O/run.log; exit 1; }; tail -n 25 $O/run.log; cp $(ls -d $O/run/*/*/ | head -1)*.csv $O/ && touch $O/DONE
